tools.name: lookup_influencer
tools.description: Public card of one Instagram influencer Starlecta tracks every day: tier, category, rounded followers and the measured engagement rate with its date. Status is open, tracked or not_listed.

tools.name: compare_influencers
tools.description: Two influencers side by side on the same method and dates: followers, engagement rate and an engagement band.

tools.name: search_influencers
tools.description: Count of matching influencers and up to two open cards. Filters: category code, tier (nano, micro, macro, mega), follower bounds, measured engagement only.

tools.name: ai_search_influencers
tools.description: One sentence in Turkish or English (2 to 200 characters), read as filters and niche words; the best candidates are then scored for relevance (detailed mode, about 30 seconds). tools.name: trend_cloud
tools.description: What influencers share in the last 7 days: rising hashtags with post counts, and the most shared products, platforms and brands with share counts. Aggregate counts only; no key needed.

tools.name: audit_influencer
tools.description: Reads one public Instagram account live and returns dated, counted metrics: followers, engagement rate over the latest items with n, average likes and comments, median Reel plays, posting frequency, Stories seen now, last post.
